name: Chart
summary: The AhaSlides chart library — one framework-free <aha-chart> for all 11 result charts (Bar, Column, Stacked, Donut, Radial, Tree map, Quadrant, Bell curve, Radar, Word cloud, Mind map), in the brand palette on app screens or the deck palette on the presenting canvas.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-chart type="…"> — draws every result chart with the same look wherever it is used: bar, column, stacked, donut (and pie), radial, treemap, quadrant, bell (rating distribution), radar, wordcloud and mindmap. Where it lives decides its colours: palette="brand" (default) for Report and any other app screen uses the --aha-viz-* brand chart palette; palette="deck" on the presenting / audience canvas takes the deck's presentationColorPalette (`colors`) and text colour (`ink`), and derives any ink that sits on a fill from that fill's contrast. The chart never paints a background. Every variant of the reference mockup is an attribute or an `options` key: Poll, Pick Answer (`correct`) and Ranking (`sort="desc"`), images on bar/column options, count / % / both, pagination (`page-size`), donut vs pie and callout / legend labels, the word-cloud shapes, image masks, rotation, colour modes and duplicate merging, the radar forms, grids, scales and eight entrance effects, the bell-curve statistics, and an editable mind map. With 0 responses every bar and column shows a short coloured stub at its starting point — no placeholder bars, no waiting text. Live data animates in place (marks grow, resize and re-rank on the --aha-motion-viz-* tokens; off under reduced motion; `replay()` re-runs the entrance), and every chart ships a text summary, a visually hidden data table and a polite live-region announcement when its data changes. Built-in copy follows `locale`, numbers use Intl for that locale, and the Presenter app can pass its own translations through `strings`.
codeNote: Set `data` (and `options`) as properties for live results — re-setting them animates the change; the `data` / `options` attributes take the same JSON for static pages. Interactive charts emit `wordcloud-hide` (a presenter hid words) and `mindmap-change` (an idea was added or renamed; detail.tree is the new tree). Result charts on app screens use this, not @ant-design/plots.

spec.label: Types
spec.value: bar · column · stacked · donut (variant donut | pie) · radial · treemap · quadrant · bell · radar · wordcloud · mindmap

spec.label: Palette
spec.value: brand = --aha-viz-series-1…6, aliases of DS colour tokens: purple-60 · coral-70 · teal-70 · pink-70 · yellow-80 · soft-indigo-80, with tints purple-15 · coral-20 · teal-20 · pink-20 · yellow-20 · soft-indigo-30 · deck = consumer colours + ink · transparent background · Other = --aha-viz-neutral → gray-70 · more than 6 bar/column options share series 1

spec.label: Ink
spec.value: --aha-viz-ink → --aha-text-default; secondary 76% / tertiary 54% / axis 26% / grid 12% / track 7% / hover 8% / pressed 16% mixes of the ink (re-derived from the deck ink on the canvas)

spec.label: Bar
spec.value: track 38 (32 past 6 options) · gap 14 · radius --aha-radius-xs (track, fill and empty stub) · value 20/600 + share 16 tertiary · image thumbnail 64 · labels clamp to 3 lines · page-size pages with a ‹ › pager

spec.label: Column
spec.value: plot 260 (+100 with images) · column ≤96 wide · gap 28 (20 past 6, 8 under 480) · label clamps to 5 lines · turns into bars when a label can't fit its slot in 4 lines

spec.label: Pick Answer
spec.value: correct = index (or data item correct:true): ✓ + bold label; correct-style=fill (default, as the mockup) paints the correct mark --aha-color-success and the rest neutral; correct-style=indicator keeps palette colours (canvas.guide Job 1 / Job 2)

spec.label: Donut · radial · tree map
spec.value: 6 slices max (the rest fold into "Other (n)") · donut ring 38% · leader-line callouts up to 5 slices from 480px wide, else a legend · radial 270° rings on a nice scale · squarified tree map with tint chips

spec.label: Bell · radar · quadrant
spec.value: bell: monotone curve per statement (≤6), average badge, optional grid / % axis / bars / ±1 SD / mean line · radar: 5 | 10 | 100 scales, filled / outline / radial bars, polygon / circle grid, 8 entrance effects, subject toggles, data table · quadrant: 2×2 zones, ≤3 colour groups, collision-aware labels

spec.label: Word cloud · mind map
spec.value: word cloud: rect / ellipse / cloud / speech bubble / heart / bulb / custom image mask, rotation, palette / top-3 / ink colour, √ / linear / log sizing, duplicate merging (case, punctuation, accents), click-to-hide with undo · mind map: balanced two-sided layout (one-sided, then an outline when narrow), 5 levels, 6 branches, +N paging, collapse, optional add / rename

spec.label: Empty
spec.value: 0 responses → every bar/column/stacked row keeps its track and shows a series-coloured stub at its start: a bar stub --aha-viz-stub-length 12px long, a column stub half the column wide and --aha-viz-mark-min-length 24px tall (under an image it spans the column and joins the image card, which rounds only the outer corners), all marks, stubs and image cards rounded with --aha-radius-xs · donut / tree map keep the track · radar breathes its entrance effect until the first response · no waiting text

spec.label: Overflow
spec.value: percentages use largest-remainder rounding so they total 100% · long labels clamp, full text in the tooltip · a column with long labels becomes bars · a wide mind map pages its ideas

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: enter 600ms + 40ms stagger · update 400ms · re-rank 350ms · values count up with their marks · --aha-ease-viz · none under prefers-reduced-motion

spec.label: A11y
spec.value: host role=figure + aria-label · text summary · hidden data table (mind map: nested list) · polite <aha-live-region> on data updates · interactive parts (pager, legend toggles, words, mind-map nodes, quadrant points, radar axes) are real buttons with labels

props.name: type
props.desc: Chart type

props.name: data
props.desc: bar/column: [{label, value, image?, correct?}] · donut/radial/treemap: [{label, value}] · wordcloud: [{label, value}] or [strings] · stacked: {series, rows:[{label, values}]} · bell: {scale, anchors, series:[{label, counts}]} · radar: {dimensions, scale, subjects:[{label, scores, responses}], people} · quadrant: {x, y, zones, groups, points:[{label, x, y, group}]} · mindmap: {label, children}

props.name: options
props.desc: Type-specific settings — donut {variant, labels, maxSize} · radial/quadrant {maxSize} · treemap {height} · bell {height, show*} · radar {height, form, grid, rings, scoreStyle, reveal, pace, show*, hollowCentre} · wordcloud {height, shape, maskSrc, rotation, colour, fontScale, removable, showTooltip, showCounts, group, foldDiacritics, maxWords} · mindmap {pageSize, maxDepth, maxBranches, editable}

props.name: palette
props.desc: brand on app screens (Report…); deck on the presenting/audience canvas

props.name: colors
props.desc: The deck's presentationColorPalette (palette=deck)

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck text colour (palette=deck)

props.name: number-format
props.desc: What each value shows

props.name: sort
props.desc: Order; desc also shows rank numbers on a bar chart (the Ranking variant). Other always stays last

props.name: highlight-top
props.desc: Dim everything below the top N

props.name: correct
props.desc: Pick Answer: the correct option(s), e.g. "1" (or correct:true on a data item)

props.name: correct-style
props.desc: fill paints the correct mark success-green and the rest neutral (the mockup); indicator keeps palette colours and marks the answer with ✓ only

props.name: page-size
props.desc: Bar: options per page, with a ‹ › pager (ranks carry across pages)

props.name: log-scale
props.desc: Log lengths for bar/column when values span orders of magnitude

props.name: legend
props.desc: Auto: on for stacked, tree map, quadrant groups, multi-subject radar, and a donut without callouts

props.name: tooltip
props.desc: Hover tooltip with the full label and value

props.name: max-items
props.desc: Cap before the smallest fold into "Other (n)"

props.name: responses
props.desc: Respondent count for the summary and the donut centre

props.name: locale
props.desc: Built-in copy (en, vi) + Intl number format

props.name: strings
props.desc: Override any built-in string with the Presenter app's translation

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name + data-table caption

props.name: replay()
props.desc: Re-runs the entrance animation with the current data

whenToUse.when: results on the presenting or audience canvas of a slide type — Poll, Pick Answer, Ranking, Rating scale, Split the points, 2×2 matrix, Word cloud, Brainstorm/Mind map
the same results anywhere else in the Presenter app — Report, dashboards, summaries
a single headline number, not a distribution
a chart type <aha-chart> does not ship (line/area/time series)

opinion.note: Never hand-roll result bars with divs or pull a chart engine into the slide canvas: the look, the empty/overflow states and the accessibility layer live here once. Pick Answer follows the mockup by default (correct mark filled with --aha-color-success, the rest neutral, plus a ✓ on the label); set correct-style="indicator" where the canvas guide's Job 1 / Job 2 split applies (palette-coloured marks, ✓ only). The --aha-viz-* values are lifted from the PRO38-69 mockup and are expected to be refined by a token owner; change the tokens, never the element.
opinion.dsv3: New in the DS (PRO38-69) — the visual source is the "AhaSlides Chart Slides" mockup; a signed-off exception to the @ant-design/plots rule for result charts.

snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

selfCheck.label: brand series from --aha-viz-series-*; deck series from colors
transparent background; Pick Answer state via ✓ (+ success fill unless correct-style=indicator)
0 responses → coloured stub at each bar/column start, no placeholder marks or waiting text
all 11 types and every mockup variant (images, modes, pagination, shapes, forms, effects)
Other bucket past the cap; long labels clamp + tooltip; columns fall back to bars
summary + hidden table + polite live region; interactive parts are labelled buttons
motion on --aha-motion-viz-*, off under reduced motion

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] is the ranked brand-palette bar chart: first fill is --aha-viz-series-1, the track and value sizes are the mockup's, the host is a labelled figure and the hidden table carries one row per option.
